title: inscriptions: mixture-corrected summed probability analysis of Latin inscriptions and Roman urban population
description: Code, preregistered analysis, and figures for applying summed probability analysis (SPA) to the Latin Inscriptions of the Roman Empire (LIRE v3.0), with a Bayesian deconvolution-mixture model that separates editorial round-number dating convention from genuine temporal signal, and relates inscription production to Hanson urban-population estimates.
